project.name: Gym Logger
project.identity: An offline-first iPhone Home Screen utility that makes Apple Notes-style gym logging easier while keeping Apple Notes as the canonical archive.
project.purpose: Reduce the interaction cost of maintaining a large Apple Notes workout log without adding accounts, cloud sync, analytics, or generic fitness-platform features.

bridge.minimumUserAction: Run the one-time gh auth login below; the active local automation then polls, notifies this product conversation, and resumes validated decisions.
bridge.why: The supported Codex app thread bridge can send a user-visible message to the existing product conversation. GitHub remains the durable decision bridge; the local automation provides scheduled polling rather than instantaneous webhook wake-up.
